images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a polished game-prop concept design overview, landscape canvas, for FOUR potion bottle grades. Grounded realistic fantasy apothecary glass bottles, physically believable studio product renders. Clean warm light-gray background, restrained professional art-direction presentation.
Layout: four equal columns, two rows of bottles. Eight bottles total, each large and completely visible. Column titles in Chinese, exactly: "普通", "中级", "高级", "特级". Small left row labels: "生命" for the upper red-liquid row, "魔力" for the lower blue-liquid row. Overall heading: "药水瓶 · 品阶设计". Small footer: "同品阶共用瓶型，仅替换液体颜色". Excellent clear Chinese typography, minimal text.
Each column shows EXACTLY THE SAME bottle geometry, glass, stopper, metal colors and camera in both rows; the ONLY change between upper and lower is ruby-red transparent liquid versus cyan-blue transparent liquid. Glass is colorless, transparent and not frosted; liquid fills ~70% of the main body, with level meniscus, not the neck. Liquid must remain visible, no opaque glowing magic.
Shared family: practical palm-size bottles about 18 cm tall, short narrow neck, same approximately 32 mm outer mouth diameter, removable pull-out cork plug construction (not screw cap), flat stable base, unobstructed lower-body grip area for one-handed drinking. Same overall scale and view, slight three-quarter front angle. No handles, no chains, no spikes, no jewels, no brand labels.
Column 1 普通: simple modest round-section cylindrical clear glass vial, straight body, rounded shoulder, very subtle rounded heel, plain exposed tan cork. Clean utilitarian silhouette, H175 W68 D68 mm.
Column 2 中级: distinct flattened pear silhouette, wide rounded lower body narrowing gently into sloping shoulders and short neck, plain smooth glass grip, simple brushed pewter neck collar, cork stopper with a low pewter disk top, subtle double glass heel ring. H180 W76 D56 mm.
Column 3 高级: distinct elongated flattened hexagonal bottle, broad flat front and back with precise polished beveled side facets, angled shoulders, gently tapered stable base, slender silver neck collar and small flat silver-topped cork plug, thin silver base rim. Facets are intentional cut glass, NOT low-poly polygon shading. H185 W74 D60 mm.
Column 4 特级: distinct refined rounded shield / softly diamond-shaped colorless crystal flask, broad curved shoulders tapering toward a clipped flat stable bottom, thick polished beveled perimeter and smooth clear central panel, restrained aged pale-brass collar and thin lower-rim framing, a simple pale-brass capped cork plug. Decoration stays around neck and extreme lower edge, never a cage across the hand or liquid. H190 W78 D62 mm.
Materials: realistic transparent glass wall thickness, believable refraction, separate liquid volume, understated tiny manufacturing variation; no heavy scratches/dirt, no vintage label. Lighting: broad softbox with dark edge reflections making clear glass contours legible. Palette: neutral background, silver/pewter then pale brass accents, red and blue liquid. Preserve strong silhouette distinctions and family consistency. The higher grade is better craftsmanship, not a giant bottle. No environment or people.

Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE landscape professional game-prop three-view design sheet from the supplied reference overview, which is an identity reference, not an image to reproduce as a whole. Use ONLY the specified bottle column. Render one and the same physical bottle in exactly THREE equally spaced orthographic views: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE (exactly 90 degrees rotation), BACK (exactly 180 degrees rotation). This is a modeling reference sheet, NOT three perspective beauty shots. All three views have the exact same height and baseline, camera at mid-body with parallel projection, no visible top surfaces caused by perspective, no perspective convergence. All three depict the same red liquid fill level and matching neck, stopper, shoulder, heel and material features. Clean warm off-white background with faint horizontal alignment guides. Large uncluttered objects, soft neutral studio illumination with controlled edge reflections to reveal clear glass wall thickness and liquid volume. No shadow interfering with silhouette. Realistic high-quality glass material, no stylized low-poly shading.
Labels beneath each object, verbatim: "正视图", "右视图", "后视图". Title at top as specified. Footer with target size as specified (a proposed design scale, not a claim of CAD precision). A tiny red swatch labelled "生命" and a tiny blue swatch labelled "魔力", with small line "共用瓶型 · 仅换液体颜色". Do not add a fourth bottle or extra product view. No icons, arrows through objects, accessories, scenery or hands.
Preserve bottle identity from the referenced column, including colorless glass, practical clear central grip area, short neck and removable cork plug. Both red and blue versions use this exact same geometry and neutral materials. The depicted THREE views all have transparent ruby-red liquid filling about 70% of body with a level meniscus. Do not tint the empty glass or neck red.
Selected reference: FIRST column marked 普通.
Bottle identity: Simple round-section cylindrical clear glass bottle with straight vertical body, rounded shoulders, thick rounded glass heel and a subtle clear glass lip ring at the mouth, plain exposed tan cork without metal cap. The body is circular in plan, so front/right/back have equal widths. No metal decoration. Match the first reference bottle closely.
Title (verbatim): "普通 · 药水瓶三视图".
Footer size (verbatim): "建议尺寸：高 175 mm · 宽 68 mm · 深 68 mm".
